title: Dedicated autoscaler: refactor burst controls + utilization reporting
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Dedicated fleets sometimes exhaust their burst allowance under short traffic spikes, which causes degraded tail latency. Additionally, fleet-level utilization metrics were noisy and hard to correlate with burst token consumption. This PR refactors the dedicated autoscaler burst control codepath to separate token bucket accounting from capacity-constrained scaling decisions, improves telemetry for per-fleet burst token usage, and provides deterministic reporting for utilization vs burst consumption.

What changed (high level): refactor token-bucket implementation into a standalone module with explicit leases; add per-fleet telemetry counters and histograms; expose a new /api/v1/dedicated/fleets/{id}/utilization endpoint for internal console use; add deterministic sampling for high qps fleets to reduce metric noise; tighten autoscaler backoff policy to avoid oscillation when burst tokens are drained.

Why: these changes reduce tail latency regressions during burst exhaustion, make utilization vs burst consumption easier to debug, and give operators actionable metrics to tune burst allowances.

Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for token bucket edge cases - [x] Integration tests for autoscaler behavior under spike tests - [x] Telemetry emits with stable metric names and tags - [x] Docs/console wiring for new utilization endpoint - [x] Canary rollout config added

Rollout plan: deploy to staging dedicated cluster, monitor metrics (dedicated.burst.tokens_remaining, dedicated.autoscaler.backoffs, dedicated.fleet.utilization_p95), canary to 10% of fleets for 24h, then full rollout. The PR includes a temporary feature flag (feature.dedicated.autoscaler.refactor) to allow fast rollback.

Notes: This is a refactor + instrumentation change; core scaling algorithm remains behaviorally similar except for the backoff tweaks when token buckets hit zero. SUP-9876 is linked for an incident where a customer saw repeated burst exhaustion during warm traffic spikes.

merge_outcome: Merged by Rina Kapoor via squash and merge. Commit message summarized refactor+telemetry+backoff-tweak. Feature flag defaulted to off for safe rollout.
release_notes: Improved burst token accounting for Dedicated fleets to reduce tail latency during short spikes.
Added per-fleet burst tokens remaining metric and utilization p95 histogram for better observability.
Introduced deterministic sampling for high-QPS fleets to reduce metric noise.
Autoscaler backoff tightened when burst tokens are exhausted to avoid oscillation.
notes: Canary rollout: use scripts/canary/deploy_canary_dedicated.sh with feature.dedicated.autoscaler.refactor=true for 10% of fleets.
Rollback: toggle feature.dedicated.autoscaler.refactor=false and redeploy the canary replicas.
